capabilities: Render mermaid blocks with bundled upstream mermaid 11.17.2 instead of Pele
Apply theme, look and themeVariables directives to diagrams
Follow the app theme (dark/light) and --font-mermaid as defaults
Re-render diagrams in the current note via command or scrolling
Show syntax errors as a single red line instead of an injected error diagram
disambiguation: Not a mermaid syntax editor or tutorial; it only swaps the rendering engine back to upstream mermaid.
extras: Hooks the internal window.pele.mount API, which may silently stop working in future Obsidian releases. Bundled mermaid adds ~3.4 MB to main.js. Automated review flags eval from the vendored mermaid bundle; the plugin itself loads no remote code and makes no network requests. zenuml diagrams are unsupported; mobile untested. Installable via BRAT.
motivation: The author wants standard mermaid configuration to work again after Obsidian replaced mermaid.js with its own Pele engine in 1.15.
problem: Since Obsidian 1.15, mermaid blocks are drawn by the internal Pele engine, which silently drops theme, look and themeVariables settings.
summary: Renders mermaid code blocks with upstream mermaid, restoring standard config like theme, look and themeVariables that Obsidian's internal engine ignores.
